title: Cold-chain shipment decision
bodyMd:
### Dispatch note
A laboratory must ship18 sealed sample boxes. Each weighs2kg. All boxes must travel together in one shipment and arrive no later than the end of day3. The dispatch day is day0. No box may be opened or split.

### Carrier quotations
| Service | Maximum shipment mass | Arrival day | Charge |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Frost |40kg|2|90 euros plus2 euros/kg|
| Glade |50kg|4|40 euros plus1 euro/kg|
| Haven |30kg|1|120 euros flat|
| Islet |45kg|3|150 euros flat|

### Procurement policy
Choose the least expensive quotation satisfying both mass and arrival requirements. The budget is160 euros. A quotation over budget cannot be selected without prior authorization, which has not been obtained.
